# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/notices.sh (cargo-about, about.toml, about.hbs) from
Cargo.lock. Do not edit; regenerate after changing dependencies. -->

This app is licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0. It contains the third-party
software listed here, whose licenses require these notices.

## Slint

The user interface is built with Slint (https://slint.dev), used under the
Slint Royalty-free Desktop, Mobile, and Web Applications License 2.0
(LicenseRef-Slint-Royalty-free-2.0, full text below). As that license requires,
the About page shows the AboutSlint widget.

## OpenH264

OpenH264 Video Codec provided by Cisco Systems, Inc.

The app does not include OpenH264. Only when you enable H.264 does it download
Cisco's prebuilt OpenH264 binary from ciscobinary.openh264.org, check it
against known checksums and load it at runtime; you can disable it again at
any time. Cisco distributes that binary under the BSD-2-Clause license
(Copyright (c) 2013, Cisco Systems; text below, used by openh264-sys2) and
covers the MPEG LA H.264 patent royalties for it.

  The Skia build includes further libraries under their own licenses:
  FreeType (FreeType License: portions of this software are copyright © The
  FreeType Project, www.freetype.org, all rights reserved), libpng (PNG
  Reference Library License), libjpeg-turbo (IJG License, BSD-3-Clause and
  zlib License: this software is based in part on the work of the Independent
  JPEG Group), zlib (zlib License), Expat (MIT), Wuffs (Apache-2.0) and the
  Vulkan Memory Allocator (MIT).

Other system libraries the app uses at runtime (ALSA, PipeWire, fontconfig,
xkbcommon, the C and C++ runtimes) belong to the operating system and are not
distributed with it.
